title: Operator assistant on a local model: read-only tools, validated answers, hybrid routing
scenario: Operators want grounded answers to 'why did machine 4 alert at 14:05?' from a small local model on the plant server, with a cloud model only when policy allows and never with raw waveforms. The model is a stub replaying recorded OpenAI-compatible turns.
task: Pydantic answer contract with an action enum that cannot change state
Read-only tools with recoverable error results and a non-raising dispatcher
Agent loop: parallel tool calls, citation checks, validate-and-retry, max turns, latency
Router: local first, cloud only by policy, no local-only tools or raw samples to the cloud
acceptance: Citations must match executed tool calls; enum and bounds enforced
Cloud never sees get_raw_capture or samples
ANSWER.md: enforcement in code, eval plan on the real model, policy governance
